product_context: One paragraph: what the board does, what it connects to, and the system it lives in (e.g. one of two identical boards in a stereo camera head).
reference_design: Vendor reference circuit/BOM the design should follow, if any (file + section).
interfaces: e.g. USB 3.2 Gen1 (90 ohm differential), I2C 400 kHz at 3.3 V, 5 V / 1.2 A input
house_rules: Schematic: functional blocks in titled boxes, net labels between blocks, short local wires only.
Routing: 45-degree bends, no 90-degree corners, Y-joints instead of T-joints.
Design decisions belong to the designer; reviewers recommend with options.
